useCases.title: Save a booking request as Draft
mainFlow: An agent can save a booking request as Draft and complete it later; drafts are invisible to officers.

useCases.title: Fill mandatory fields before submission
mainFlow: The booking form requires vessel, berth, ETA, ETD and cargo class before it can be submitted.

useCases.title: Submit a booking request
preconditions: ETD must be later than ETA
Stay (ETD - ETA) must not exceed 30 days
IMO Number must be exactly 7 digits (screenshot-only rule, not in prose: fig-booking-form-validation.png)
mainFlow: On submission the system assigns a unique booking reference in the format HB-YYYY-NNNNN.
A booking request cannot be submitted more than 90 days before the ETA.
A booking request must be submitted at least 48 hours before the ETA.
useCases.notes: Validation rule 'ETD must be later than ETA, and the system rejects a stay longer than 30 days' is in 09-booking-request-form.md#L37; the IMO-digit rule exists ONLY in the screenshot fig-booking-form-validation.png (read via vision, not stated in any page's prose).

useCases.title: Booking status model
mainFlow: A booking request moves through the states Draft, Submitted, Under Review, Approved, Rejected, Cancelled and Completed.

useCases.title: Fast-track auto-approval (CONTRADICTED — see OQ-1)
mainFlow: A booking request is automatically approved when the requested berth is free for the whole stay and the vessel is shorter than 120 metres.
useCases.notes: Directly contradicted by 15-officer-review-process.md#L41 ('There is no automatic approval; every booking request is reviewed by a berth officer'). See openQuestions OQ-1. Drafting position taken (ASSUMED, PROJECT.md Ruling): this use case is NOT built as literal auto-approval; ch15 governs. Kept here for traceability of the source statement.

useCases.title: Berth officers review every booking and record a reasoned decision
mainFlow: Berth officers review every booking request and record an approval decision with a reason.

useCases.title: Edit a Submitted booking request
mainFlow: An agent may edit a Submitted request until an officer opens it for review, after which it is locked.

useCases.title: Cancel a booking request
mainFlow: An Approved booking may be cancelled by the agent; a Completed booking cannot be cancelled.
Cancellation is free of charge until 24 hours before ETA (10-cancellation-and-changes.md#L32) — CONTRADICTS the 72-hour fee window below; see OQ-2.
Cancellations made within 72 hours of ETA are charged 50% of the berth fee (19-tariffs-cancellation-fees.md#L37).
useCases.notes: Drafting position taken (ASSUMED, PROJECT.md Ruling): the specific fee schedule (ch19) governs the 24-72h overlap — free only when cancelled more than 72h before ETA, 50% charged from 72h down to ETA.

useCases.title: Late-arrival surcharge
mainFlow: A vessel arriving more than 2 hours after its ETA incurs a late-arrival surcharge of 15% of the berth fee.

useCases.title: Attach cargo manifest to a booking request (workshop-only, not in any chapter)
mainFlow: Agents must be able to attach the cargo manifest as a PDF to a booking request.
useCases.notes: Raised only in workshop-notes.md Session 2, never promoted into a numbered chapter (ADR-007: workshop notes kept verbatim, clean-up happens in chapters — clean-up evidently never happened for this item). Attachment size limit explicitly 'not decided' in the same notes. See openQuestions OQ-4.

openQuestions.question: Fast-track auto-approval (08 §4.4) directly contradicts 'no automatic approval, manual review only' (15 §11.4). Which governs?
openQuestions.assumption: Manual review governs; ch8's Fast-track section is read as expedited queue priority, not a bypass of officer review.

openQuestions.question: Cancellation fee: 'free until 24h before ETA' (10 §6.2) vs '50% charge within 72h of ETA' (19 §15.2) overlap in the 24-72h window. Which governs?
openQuestions.assumption: The specific fee schedule (ch19) governs the overlap: free only when cancelled more than 72h before ETA, 50% charged from 72h down to ETA.

openQuestions.question: Cargo manifest PDF attachment (workshop-notes.md Session 2) — build it, and if so what is the size limit?
openQuestions.assumption: Build the attachment capability (agents explicitly asked for it in workshop); size limit left as an implementation default (10 MB) since the workshop notes record it as undecided.
